title: Roles Management
noPermissionAlert: Role "{name}" has no access permissions yet. Please enable at least 1 permission first.

permissions_manage.title: Manage Permission
permissions_manage.desc: Manages permission and create and assign roles to other people.

dashboard.title: See DashBoard
dashboard.desc: Be able to see activity on the dashboard and export it as pdf or png.

parking.title: See Parking
parking.desc: Be able to see parked vehicles, empty slots and obstructed slots for further fixing.

heatmap.title: See Heatmap
heatmap.desc: Be able to see percentage of people who parked in each floor throughout the day and week.

reports.title: See Reports
reports.desc: Be able to see daily, weekly, monthly, yearly revenue.

qr.title: See QR Code
qr.desc: Be able to create a fixed QR code for customers to scan and see where they had parked their vehicles.

system_access.title: System Access
system_access.desc: Be able to access and configure main system.
